interpretation: Zero allocation applies to the named warmed operation only; initialization, growth, user callbacks, TMP layout, frame rendering and unrelated engine work are outside its measured window.
Native p50/p95 fields describe the distribution of per-batch mean operation times, not an individual-call tail latency. Timing has no pass/fail threshold.
Managed before/after timings use actual sources with finite Unity boundaries on a shared VM; prioritize deterministic allocation counts and complexity, not device speedup claims.
RTree has broad differential correctness and reusable-query allocation checks; actual spatial-query timing depends on overlap/distribution and query size.
